text: The Simion Stoilow Prize (Romanian: Premiul Simion Stoilow) is a mathematical award given by the Romanian Academy to recognize achievements in mathematics, named in honor of Simion Stoilow. It can be awarded either for a single mathematical work or for a series of works. The prize includes a monetary award of 2,000 lei and a diploma. It was established in 1963 and is awarded annually, though the actual presentation of the prizes occurs two years after the year in which they are designated. Notable recipients of the prize include various mathematicians, though specific names are not listed in the provided text.
